title: Shoes Outlet Game
description: In this idle game, simplicity is key! Tap your way to success as you build and expand your outlets from mini to mega. It's easy, it's fun, and it's all about the joy of watching your mall grow with minimal effort! Become a retail tycoon without breaking a sweat! Effortlessly manage your dream mall by hiring staff and making strategic decisions. Deal with displaying goods, cleaning fitting rooms, and helping customers check out. Fear not, for you can build your own dream team and manage them efficiently, turning challenges into opportunities and making every coin count!

title: Planet Destroy Idle
description:
Planet Destroy Idle - Smash planets to pieces!

Craft powerful tools like pickaxes, swords, axes, and arrows to strike and destroy planets while collecting valuable resources. Complete quests, unlock achievements, and upgrade your tools to maximize destruction.

Use the prestige system with unique perks to come back stronger and smash even bigger planets. Every hit brings progress, and every new planet opens up new opportunities for chaos.

Become the ultimate destroyer and show the planets who’s in charge!
